spells.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
spells.effect: Set up a **Mortalis Terminexus** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mortalis Terminexus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Nighthaunt Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
spells.effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Nighthaunt Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Summon Vault of Souls
spells.effect: Set up a **Vault of Souls** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vault of Souls** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Nighthaunt Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
